invariants.rationale: The method accesses element methods and attributes; element must be non-null.
The method calls map.getProperties() and map.getTileSets(); map must be non-null.
The method calls parentLayers.add(layer); parentLayers must be non-null.
The method invokes element.getName().equals(...), so getName() is expected to not return null.
The method accesses map.getProperties().get(...); so map.getProperties() must be non-null.
